ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the center of the circle O is at the coordinate origin, the x-axis is horizontal to the right, and the y-axis is vertical upward. Point A is the intersection point of the circle and the positive half-axis of the x-axis. Point P is located on the upper-left side of the circumference. Line segment PA is a chord, OA is a radius, and the problem gives ∠PAO=37°. Reasoning: The charge of a proton is e. In a uniform electric field, the increase in kinetic energy from a fixed point P to a point Q on the circle equals the work done by the electric force: ΔK=eE·(r_Q-r_P). On the circumference, to make the linear quantity E·r_Q maximal, Q should be the endpoint of the circumference pointed to by the direction of the electric field. In the problem the maximum point is A, so the electric field direction is along the +x direction. When reaching A, the kinetic energy increases by 60 eV, which corresponds to a potential difference of 60 V, so E(x_A-x_P)=60 V. From the figure, P is on the circle, OA=OP=R=25 cm=0.25 m, triangle OAP is an isosceles triangle, and ∠PAO=37°. The chord length AP=2Rcos37°. The horizontal distance from A to P is x_A-x_P=APcos37°=2Rcos²37°. Taking cos37°≈0.8, then x_A-x_P=2×0.25×0.8²=0.32 m. Therefore E=60/0.32=187.5 V/m.

raw_record.question_text: As shown in the figure, in the xOy plane there is a uniform electric field. A group of protons starts from point P and can reach any position on circle O. Comparing these positions on the circle, it is found that when they reach point A, the intersection point of the circle and the positive half-axis of the x-axis, the increase in kinetic energy is the greatest, and it increases by 60eV. It is known that the radius of the circle is 25cm, and \(\angle PAO=37^\circ\). Find the electric field strength of the uniform electric field.

method.method_draft: 先从图像读出：圆心O在坐标原点，A是圆与x轴正半轴的交点，P位于圆周左上方，PA是一条弦，OA是半径且沿x轴负向看向A点的夹角为∠PAO。再由题文取半径R=25 cm、∠PAO=37°、到达A点时质子动能增加最大且增加60 eV。对匀强电场，质子从固定点P到圆上一点Q的动能增量为电场力做功：ΔK=eE·(r_Q-r_P)。在圆上使线性量E·r_Q最大的点位于电场方向指向的圆周端点；既然最大点是A，说明电场沿+x方向。于是60 eV对应电势差60 V，有E(x_A-x_P)=60 V。由图中P在圆上，三角形OAP中OA=OP=R，且∠PAO=37°，弦长AP=2Rcos37°，水平位移x_A-x_P=APcos37°=2Rcos^2 37°。代入R=0.25 m、cos37°≈0.8，得x_A-x_P=2×0.25×0.64=0.32 m，所以E=60/0.32=187.5 V/m。
method.CoT_raw:

推理：质子电荷量为e，在匀强电场中从固定点P到圆上一点Q的动能增加量等于电场力做功：ΔK=eE·(r_Q-r_P)。在圆周上，要使线性量E·r_Q最大，Q应为电场方向所指向的圆周端点。题中最大点是A，所以电场方向沿+x方向。到达A时动能增加60 eV，即对应电势差60 V，因此有 E(x_A-x_P)=60 V。

由图中P在圆上，OA=OP=R=25 cm=0.25 m，三角形OAP为等腰三角形，且∠PAO=37°。弦长 AP=2Rcos37°。A到P的水平距离为 x_A-x_P=APcos37°=2Rcos²37°。取cos37°≈0.8，则 x_A-x_P=2×0.25×0.8²=0.32 m。

所以 E=60/0.32=187.5 V/m。
